enemies/* sprite maps still interim/upscaled, usage-ranked): enemies/hatch (2f 20×10 → 30×15 served; armoured hatch releases fliers, frame 1 lid open) incl its auto-derived @flash sibling — the 2 cells cropped to their measured subject boxes with the 6-px key border clamped inside each cell; state xors 63% over the interim animation floor 0.4%. The design carries its own 1-px outline, so the outline pass is off.

Pixel-art sprite sheet for a horizontal arcade shoot-'em-up: the two animation frames of the HATCH — an armoured ground hatch about 2:1 wide that snaps open to release small fliers.

Design identity to keep exactly — a low armoured bay wide as a door: a heavy steel dome lid (#7a8296 body, pale #b8c0d0 top edge, slate #434a60 shadow seams) marked with two red-and-amber hazard chevrons (#d83850 with #f8c838), resting on a darker steel sill frame with a near-black outline (#141026); the bay interior is pitch black (#05030c). Industrial, ground-bolted, menace by hint rather than size.

Rebuild it as a sprite sheet under this strict contract:
- On a CONTINUOUS flat pure bright green chroma-key background, exactly hex #51e018, identical solid colour in every background pixel: no gradient, no vignette, no shadow, no floor plane, no panel, no second green shade.
- EXACTLY 2 cells laid out as 1 ROW OF 2 (2-column by 1-row) — every cell holding exactly ONE hatch in the same ground position; a missing, empty or merged cell ruins the entire sheet.
- Cells in reading order (left-right, then top-bottom):
  cell 1 = the hatch CLOSED — the steel lid flush on its sill, hazard chevrons centred, no gap. The subject lies within aspect 1.30:1 to 2.35:1.
  cell 2 = the SAME hatch OPEN — the lid split and raised on two short side struts at the left and right edges, exposing the black bay interior across the middle with a faint amber glow deep inside; the sill and overall width unchanged. The subject lies within aspect 1.30:1 to 2.35:1.
- The sheet canvas measures EXACTLY 576×256 px. Produce EXACTLY 2 subject cells — no more, no fewer — and nothing else on the sheet.
- Each subject sits well inside its cell with at least 12 px of unbroken flat #51e018 around it and clean flat gutters between cells: no subject may touch or cross a cell edge; keep every subject within the inner 75% of its cell.
- CENTRING AND SIZE: every subject sits at the exact centre of its cell at the same scale and position as the other cell — only the named state changes.
- NO guide lines, NO cell borders, NO divider lines, NO frames, NO text, NO labels, NO numbers anywhere on the sheet — the cell names above are ordering instructions and must NEVER be drawn.
- Style: the finest retro pixel art for its native resolution — as much detail and inner structure as possible AT that low resolution, crisp hard-edged square pixels, chunky bold forms, a rich four-to-six step shading ramp lit from the top-left with careful inner detail and real material texture, clean saturated colours, a 1-px near-black outline on every silhouette edge, no anti-aliasing, no blur, no smooth gradients.
